summary: Integer Holdings Corp. filed an 8-K disclosing entry into a definitive merger agreement with Armstrong Parent and Armstrong Bidco, affiliates of KKR. Under the agreement, each share of Integer common stock will be converted into the right to receive $127.00 in cash, a transaction that will result in Integer becoming a wholly owned subsidiary of KKR-controlled Parent and delisting from the NYSE. The all-cash consideration implies a premium, though the filing does not state the premium percentage. Equity awards will be cashed out, with vested and transaction-vesting RSUs paid in full and unvested RSUs paid 50% at closing and 50% on a tranche-by-tranche basis. The deal is subject to shareholder approval and customary closing conditions, with appraisal rights available. Watch for shareholder vote timing and any competing bids.
